info.description: The operations an API key can call in Offload Security 1.4.0. Authenticate with the `X-API-Key` header; each operation lists the key scope it needs (`x-offload-api-key-scope`). Routes not listed here are the web interface's internal API: they accept only a signed-in session and may change without notice. Paths are relative to your own deployment, e.g. https://offload.example.com.

SaveRiskAppetiteRequest.description:
Request model for saving risk appetite.

``scale`` selects which risk scale the appetite applies to:
``business`` (1-25) or ``system`` (0-100). Tolerance and thresholds
are validated against that scale in the service layer. Without
this, a 0-100 default was silently applied to 1-25 business
scores, making every business risk "within appetite".
